The 27-inch inflatable you're looking at is really made for the floor — great for a big, bold display, but 27 inches is a lot for a desk. For a true desktop piece, our top pick is the Frank L. Wright Collection BARREL Bronze Metallic Desktop Globe — a compact, hand-finished heirloom-quality globe with a striking bronze metallic design, perfect for a desk or shelf.

You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
